name: Hedge
overview: The biblical concept of a hedge symbolizes divine protection and boundaries, as seen in Job 1:10 where God is described as making a hedge around Job and his possessions. This protection can also be a form of restraint, as Lamentations 3:7 illustrates God hedging a person in so they cannot escape. Hedges are portrayed as both physical barriers, such as fences or walls around vineyards (Isaiah 5:5), and metaphorical obstacles like thorns representing the way of the slothful (Proverbs 15:19). Additionally, hedges serve as places where people dwell or move about, as Jeremiah 49:3 depicts lamenters running to and fro by the hedges, and Ezekiel 13:5 uses the imagery of hedges as defenses Israel must maintain in spiritual battle.
